items.title: Colon section typed with the small-intestine list
items.text: This sigmoid colon section was annotated with the small-intestine list. 'Enterocytes' barely express their markers (APOB 15%, MGAM 6%) but are colonocytes (AQP8 0.76, CEACAM7 0.95, SLC26A3 0.98). Two 'Goblet' sub-clusters (1,725 cells) are colonocytes too (SLC26A3 94%, CA1 98%), and the goblet markers do not separate goblet cells (ITLN1 0.94 vs 0.73). Annotate this slice with a colon list: Colonocytes CA1+ SLC26A3+ AQP8+ CEACAM7+, goblet markers checked on this slice, no Paneth or M cells (U-1).

action.request: Draft a colon marker list for 167799 from organ_marker_draft('colon') and the refinements of the ileum list, check it and propose it.

check.reason: The SI list misfits this colon slice: enterocyte markers absent and colonocytes split into Goblet.
check.evidence: review_markers: Enterocytes APOB 0.15, MGAM 0.06 but AQP8 0.76, CEACAM7 0.95; type_structure Goblet /3 (1,285) SLC26A3 0.94 CA1 0.98, /4 (440) CEACAM7/TFF1; ITLN1 0.94 vs 0.73; organ_marker_draft('colon') resolves Colonocytes in this panel.

items.title: Arterial EC are left Unassigned
items.text: The 334 Unassigned cells are arterial endothelium: NOTCH4 0.78, BMX 0.69, HEY1 0.55, PECAM1 0.89, IGFBP3 0.85, next to pericytes. Meanwhile the 191 'Arterial EC' have no arterial genes (GJA4 7%, HEY1 9%) and 77% carry ACKR1, the venous marker. Set Arterial EC to BMX+ NOTCH4+ HEY1+ IGFBP3+ ACKR1-.

check.reason: Unassigned cells carry a clear arterial EC signature and the current Arterial EC do not.
check.evidence: review_markers unassigned: NOTCH4 0.78, BMX 0.69, HEY1 0.55, IGFBP3 0.85; spatial_profile Unassigned neighbour pericytes log2 2.17; Arterial EC GJA4 0.07, HEY1 0.09, ACKR1 0.77; Arterial/Venous confusion 0.28.

items.title: 'B cells' are mostly plasma cells
items.text: Of the 74 'B cells', MS4A1 is in 14% and TNFRSF17 in 62%; they sit in the lamina propria next to plasma cells (log2 3.6), not in a follicle (COL-07). B vs plasma confusion is 0.32. Require MS4A1 for B cells (e.g. MS4A1+ BANK1+ FCRL1+ TNFRSF17-) so these join the plasma cells.

check.reason: B cells lack MS4A1 and carry plasma-cell genes; they sit among plasma cells, not in follicles.
check.evidence: MS4A1 0.14, TNFRSF17 0.62; B/plasma confusion 0.32; spatial_profile B cells 2.9 um from epithelium, neighbour plasma cells log2 3.56.

items.title: 'Neutrophils' are monocytes and macrophages
items.text: The 278 'Neutrophils' lack neutrophil genes (FCGR3B 19%, CXCR2 5%, CMTM2 1%); 60% are C1QC+ macrophage-like, 20% FCN1+ CSTA+ monocytes. Use neutrophil markers this panel detects (S100A12, MGAM, CXCL8) or drop the type here; the FCN1+ cells then go to Monocytes.

check.reason: No neutrophil programme; sub-clusters are macrophage-, endothelial-doublet- and monocyte-like.
check.evidence: FCGR3B 0.19, CXCR2 0.05, CMTM2 0.01; type_structure /0 C1QC 0.51, /1 VWF/LIFR, /2 FCN1 0.72.

items.title: gd T cells cannot be told from CD8 T cells
items.text: TRDC is in 12% of the 181 'gd T cells', which look like cytotoxic CD8 T cells (GZMH 0.62, GZMK 0.57, KLRC2 0.61). CD8/gd confusion is 0.34, above the merge threshold. Merge them into CD8 T cells for this slice, or keep gd T only for TRDC+ cells.

check.reason: TRDC rarely detected; cells are cytotoxic CD8-like and the model cannot separate them.

items.title: Draw the mucosa so the colon priors apply
items.text: No regions are drawn, so your U-1 rule (no Paneth cells in the mucosa) and the region rules COL-01/06/13 do nothing yet. Epithelium is where COL-01 expects it (only 23 out-of-place epithelial cells). Drawing the mucosa from the epithelial cells, as on 147328, would activate them.

action.request: Outline the mucosa of 167799 with preview_compartment from the epithelial and lamina propria cells and propose it as region 'mucosa'.

check.reason: Without regions the user's U-1 and the COL region rules cannot act; the mucosa is easy to outline.
check.evidence: list_regions/summary: no regions; check_plausibility: only 23 out-of-place epithelial cells; U-1 rule is region=mucosa.

items.title: Epithelial transcript spill-over into the lamina propria
items.text: 59% of non-epithelial cells within 10 um of epithelium carry epithelial markers (10% beyond 60 um); telocytes show EPCAM 0.53 and KRT8 0.51. Registration is fine (max offset 5.2 um), so this is segmentation spill-over; telocytes are still typed correctly by BMP5/EDNRB.

check.reason: Spill-over is real but harmless here: telocytes are still typed by BMP5/EDNRB and no action changes the annotation.
